read_shapenet_csv: read a ShapeNet metadata CSV file and return keyword-to-id and id-to-keyword mapping dictionaries
to_relative_pos: convert absolute block positions in a block list to relative positions by finding the minimum origin offset
blocks_list_to_npy: convert a list of block positions with id and meta into a compact numpy array representation
npy_to_blocks_list: convert a numpy array back into a list of block positions with id and meta tuples
blocks_list_add_offset: offset all block positions in a block list by a constant xyz coordinate
